memory_update.text: FORM should be carried forward as a high-confidence underfollowed HBM test/probe-card candidate because the company disclosed volume shipments to all three major HBM manufacturers.
ONTO should be carried forward as a high-confidence HBM inspection/metrology candidate due to a disclosed $240M-plus HBM volume purchase agreement through 2027.
KLIC should remain in the funnel as a hypothesis-stage HBM/advanced-packaging bonding-tools candidate; require evidence that first HBM system shipment becomes production revenue.

For HBM sub-suppliers, the most evidence-backed US-listed subnodes in this pass are probe cards/known-good-die testing, inspection/metrology, thermocompression/FTC bonding, and OSAT advanced-packaging capacity anchors.

Need a later pass on US-listed or ADR materials suppliers for underfill, thermal interface materials, substrates, photoresists, dicing, wafer thinning, sockets and handlers; this pass skewed toward tools and process control because public evidence was stronger.

node: HBM and advanced-packaging sub-suppliers one or two layers below memory producers
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around HBM and advanced-packaging sub-suppliers with a two-lane funnel: AMKR as a reference OSAT/context anchor, and FORM, ONTO, and KLIC as underfollowed or semi-underfollowed tool/metrology/test beneficiaries. The strongest direct evidence in this pass is FORM shipping HBM probe cards to all three major HBM manufacturers and ONTO closing a large HBM inspection/metrology volume purchase agreement. KLIC has credible advanced-packaging/FTC exposure and reported first HBM-system shipment, but the size and durability of HBM revenue need verification. This is research mapping only, not a trading recommendation.
